title: ZXTank Privacy Information
description: Learn how ZXTank uses Apple services, stores game settings and how privacy information will be updated before release.
summary: Protecting player privacy is important to BarkinMad Studios. This page will be updated with verified information before ZXTank is released.
heroImageAlt: Illustration representing privacy and data protection in ZXTank

sections.heading: Privacy During Development
paragraphs: ZXTank is currently in active development and is not yet available on the App Store.
This page provides the current privacy information available for the project. It will be updated before release to reflect the final app configuration and published App Store privacy details.

sections.heading: Apple Services
paragraphs: ZXTank is designed to support Apple Game Center features such as achievements and leaderboards. If these services are available, they operate through your Apple account and are subject to Apple's own privacy policies.
The game may also store settings locally on your device to remember gameplay preferences and improve your experience.

sections.heading: Game Data
paragraphs: Gameplay settings and player preferences may be stored on your device to provide a consistent experience between play sessions.
Additional cloud-based features, if introduced in future updates, will be clearly documented before they become available.

sections.heading: Advertising & Online Services
paragraphs: If ZXTank includes advertising, analytics, remote configuration or other online services, they will only be enabled after appropriate testing and verification.
Before release, this page will be updated with details of any services used, the purpose they serve and the choices available to players.

sections.heading: Your Privacy Choices
paragraphs: Where applicable, ZXTank will respect the privacy controls provided by iOS, including Apple's App Tracking Transparency framework and any in-app consent options that are available.
Instructions for managing privacy-related settings will be added before release if they are relevant to the final version of the game.

sections.heading: Learn More
paragraphs: For general information about how BarkinMad Studios protects your privacy, please read the [BarkinMad Studios Privacy Policy](/privacy).
If you have a privacy question about ZXTank, please contact BarkinMad Studios using the [Contact Page](/contact).
